verdict.rationale: Zulip provides an official integrations directory with 130+ native integrations plus Zapier/IFTTT connectors, which are installable by admins without custom coding (zulip-docs-9, zulip-docs-13, zulip-docs-19). missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of the install UX or marketplace browsing experience, and no detail on admin-specific installation controls or permissions.
